title: AI-agent liability claim — disputed quantum (clause 7.2 exclusion)
rationale: The covered incident is conceded; only quantum is disputed. The policy's committed criteria make exactly two loss components machine-verifiable — remediation invoices A and B (15000 USD each, QC-1/QC-2), both hash-committed as authenticated payment evidence — while clause 7.2 (QC-3) excludes the claimed 20000 USD of consequential losses (lost margin, goodwill) regardless of proof. Payable quantum: 30000 USD, within ±10% for agreement scoring.
